_a.n.i.s.h_18: Lucien Anish came up on Day 9 carrying news from Millbank. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at Q-F12. Lucien Anish was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Karel Izaya of the Concord (@ronin_izaya).
Jonas "Lucky" Anish joined Q-F12 under the shadow of Lucien Anish's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
jromano00: Severin Jromano arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
kmorgan_zzzzz: Zeno Zzzzz took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Zeno Zzzzz came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Zeno Zzzzz watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
lewis.c.r.2166: Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis stepped off the supply cart at T-F6 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In T-F6, Henrik "Rabbit" Lewis listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
martin.duran67: They issued Norbert Duran a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lock of hair in a matchbox in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
rafaelle_nistico: At the depot, Jakub Nistico had practised answering to his name. At R-F20, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-F20 and grazed Jakub Nistico's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Clement Wanter of the Hegemony (@wanter_cz).

Jakub Nistico no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Jakub Nistico wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Jakub Nistico wrote a letter for Karel "Button" Nikola's mother, because Button could not find the words. Button signed it.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Jakub Nistico in the open at R-F20. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Benedikt Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Jakub Nistico fell at R-F20 and never moved again. Shot by Benedikt Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg).
Florian "Lucky" Nistico asked about Jakub Nistico on arriving at R-F20. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
A bullet hit Florian "Lucky" Nistico's belt buckle at R-F20 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Benedikt Kfg of the Hegemony (@felix.kfg).
Florian "Lucky" Nistico was hit in the foot through his boot at R-F20. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Matthias Universal of the Hegemony (@chamra_universal).

A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Florian "Lucky" Nistico. Nobody pretends that is not how it works. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Florian "Lucky" Nistico looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
